description: This file provides data access functions (CRUD operations) for managing TestCase, Execution, and Report entities in a database, acting as a repository layer in the application.

methods.name: TestCase create_test_case(title: str, description: str = "", status: str = "draft")
methods.description: Creates and saves a new TestCase object with provided title, description, and status.

methods.name: Optional[TestCase] get_test_case(test_case_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieves a TestCase object by its ID.

methods.name: List[TestCase] list_test_cases()
methods.description: Returns all TestCase objects ordered by descending ID.

methods.name: Optional[TestCase] update_test_case(test_case_id: int, **fields)
methods.description: Updates fields of an existing TestCase identified by ID.

methods.name: bool delete_test_case(test_case_id: int)
methods.description: Deletes a TestCase and related objects from the database by ID.

methods.name: Optional[Execution] create_execution(test_case_id: int, status: str = "queued")
methods.description: Creates a new Execution linked to a specific TestCase.

methods.name: Optional[Execution] update_execution(execution_id: int, **fields)
methods.description: Updates fields of an existing Execution identified by ID.

methods.name: Optional[Report] create_report(execution_id: int, summary: str = "", details: str = "")
methods.description: Creates a new Report associated with a specific Execution.

methods.name: Optional[Report] get_report(execution_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieves a Report by the related Execution ID.

ctags.name: create_report
ctags.pattern: /^def create_report(execution_id: int, summary: str = "", details: str = "") -> Optional[Report]:$/

ctags.name: create_test_case
ctags.pattern: /^def create_test_case(title: str, description: str = "", status: str = "draft") -> TestCase:$/
